source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def intervals(size, dividers):
        bounds = [-1] + dividers + [size]
        return [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(bounds, bounds[1:])]
    row_blocks = intervals(h, horizontal)
    col_blocks = intervals(w, vertical)
    r0, r1 = row_blocks[0]
    c0, c1 = col_blocks[-1]
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ra, rb in row_blocks:
        for ca, cb in col_blocks:
            for r in range(ra, rb):
                for c in range(ca, cb):
                    out[r][c] = pattern[r - ra][c - ca]
    return out
'''
